items.title: From Lab to Life: How Digital Avatar Technology Is Redefining Biomedical Research
items.summary: By Rachel Hopton, Ph.D., Technical Program Manager at AV Modern warfighters operate in an environment where some of the most dangerous threats are the least visible.
